videos.title: Abadas
videos.description: Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren, a delicious chocolate cake. One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling.

videos.title: Peicein
videos.description: Children's Day is approaching, and Petit and his friends decide they will give their parents clues on what gift they want. Even though the youngsters don't receive their exact wishes, they end up exchanging presents to get what they all wanted.

videos.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag
videos.description: Pompon becomes upset after missing the sunrise with Rita due to brushing his teeth. He resolves to eat only 'clean' food henceforth, hoping to avoid dirtying his teeth and future tooth-brushing delays.

videos.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh
videos.description: It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it. Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs try to get him out.

videos.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach
videos.description: Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can't stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he's cheating but in fact he's playing the game perfectly.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Mr. Krabs has a holiday and makes Larry the Lobster the temporary manager of the Krusty Krab.

videos.title: An Sgoil
videos.description: Tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class, but Mr Hobson is not sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that's behind the artwork.

videos.title: Alba Eagalach
videos.description: Gheibh sinn a-mach mu chuid de na nithean neònach os-nàdarrach a tha tric a' nochdadh ann am beul-aithris le teintean-biorach, caointichean agus tàcharain nam measg. Explore the paranormal through some of the strangest phenomena in Scottish folklore.

videos.title: Belle and Sebastian
videos.description: When there's a school presentation to work on in the holidays, about regional animals during winter, Cameron wants the highest marks in the class and, as usual, he decides to cheat.

videos.title: An Là
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Presenting local, national, and international news and information.

videos.title: Faodail: Beatha nan Eilean
videos.description: Footage from the Faodail Found Film Archive of the Outer Hebrides from the 1930s to the 1980s, charting growing up in the islands.

videos.title: Somhairle Spins
videos.description: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a' chiad latha aca a' rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide.

videos.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
videos.description: 'Skipinnish' le 'Alive' ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a' comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. 'Skipinnish' perform 'Alive' in front of fans celebrating 25 years of the band.

videos.title: Mas Fhior
videos.description: Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize?

videos.title: Orain Oir
videos.description: Archive performances of Gaelic song through the decades.

videos.title: Bus Ghlaschú
videos.description: The story of the Glasgow bus, a lifeline between Donegal and the Scottish city. A unique insight into the bus passengers, from the Donegal emigrants of the 1960s to holidaymakers travelling back and forward.

videos.title: Dàna: Scotland's Wild Side
videos.description: Suidhichte taobh a-staigh Cearcall na h-Artaig, tha Eileanan Lofoten ann an Nirribhidh a' tabhann luach fad-beatha de thoileachas don luchd-turais a bhitheas a' tadhal ann. Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb.

videos.title: Greim-Bidh le Gregor
videos.description: Gregor MacLeod takes fresh langoustines from a local fisherman to make paella, plus raspberry jam from an honesty box is used in a roly-poly. He shares his recipe for fruit and nutcrackers to have alongside a selection of his favourite cheeses.

videos.title: Seirm
videos.description: Traditional and roots music presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Featuring performances from Genticorum, Pine Tree Flyers, Kathryn Tickell and the Darkening, Tim O'Brien and Jan Fabricius and Katie Macfarlane.

videos.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal
videos.description: Tha Daisy a' strì ri bhith beò, tha teaghlach Joshua ag ullachadh airson a chall, agus tha Méabh a' tilleadh dhachaigh. Daisy fights for survival and Joshua's family faces loss.

videos.title: Fraochy Bay
videos.description: Fraochy Bay WebTV are doing it themselves, but will the lucky recipient Walter McSwain feel at home when it's time for the big reveal?

videos.title: Aig an Taigh le Abigail
videos.description: Tha Abigail a' dèanamh Fritearan de Mhearag-bheag is Peasair. Abigail shares her recipe for fresh and crispy courgette and pea fritters.

videos.title: Tannadice '87
videos.description: The remarkable story of Dundee United's journey to reach the 1987 UEFA Cup final, a feat that many believed impossible.

videos.title: Belladrum
videos.description: Classic disco from funk stars Nile Rodgers & Chic from Saturday at Belladrum, 2022.

videos.title: Somhairle Spins
videos.description: Somhairle and his university friends take on the infamous Five Ferries cycle route, with an entertaining mix of experience, resulting in tired legs and sore backsides!

videos.title: Somhairle Spins
videos.description: After a tough start, Somhairle and Innes continue riding the Badger Divide, where they encounter mechanical issues, torrential rain, shortcuts, wrong turns and lost baggage!

videos.title: Live: Serie A Football
videos.description: Ball-coise beò bho Serie A le Sassuolo a' cur fàilte air Napoli. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le Ailig O' Henley a' preasantadh bho oir na pàirce agus aithris bho Micheal Steele. Football action from Serie A as Sassuolo welcome Napoli. Presented pitchside with Alex O' Henley, commentary comes from Micheal Steele.

videos.title: Losgannan
videos.description: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a' dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

videos.title: Na Clangers
videos.description: Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he went missing from his home. However, with a little help from his new friends, he might be able to find his way back home to Planet Dùd.

videos.title: Na Clangers
videos.description: Tha dùbhradh grèine dol bhith ann 's tha 'ad uile air bhioran mun seo! There's going to be a solar eclipse and everyone is excited about it. However, the Iron Chicken is eclipsing the eclipse.

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today's play date, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea. However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Bernie has a girlfriend, and she's on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her. Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

videos.title: Bing
videos.description: Tha Bing agus a charaidean a' tarraing dealbh dha Gilly. Bing and his friends are drawing a picture for Gilly.

videos.title: Bing
videos.description: Tha Bing aig Pàrtaidh Aodach-oidhch' aig taigh Sula agus tha e a' gabhail an eagail. Bing is at a pyjama party at Sula's house and he gets frightened.

videos.title: Peicein
videos.description: Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace, but his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor, and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

videos.title: Hilda
videos.description: There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh's nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night-time.

videos.title: Geamaichean Gorach
videos.description: We're in Russia today with Coinneach Clogaid and Olaidh Orains.

videos.title: Geamaichean Gorach
videos.description: Coinneach Clogaid, thanks to another one of his ideas, is very creative today.

videos.title: Flix
videos.description: Flix is eager to hang out and help out Munchkin at the Tiger Milk Café, when Munchkin's parents leave him in charge for a few hours. However, Flix's enthusiastic efforts to help backfire.

videos.title: A-null 's a-nall
videos.description: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp', tha Denis a' sealltainn dhaibh uile g' eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

videos.title: An Là
videos.description: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Presenting local, national, and international news and information.

videos.title: Seachd Là
videos.description: Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

videos.title: Alleluia
videos.description: Kathleen Graham sings Psalm 72, Calum Alex MacMillan sings Criosda a-mhàin and Chrissie Mary MacNeil tells how her faith has helped her deal with life-threatening illness in the family.

videos.title: Port An Obain
videos.description: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea Captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star.

videos.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
videos.description: Interior designer Erica Macpherson transforms rooms, homes and businesses. Follows her process from architectural plans to trawling auction houses and shops for the finishing touches.

videos.title: Duncan Mackenzie: Dìleab nam Beann
videos.description: The story of one person's passion for the wild landscape of north west Scotland. As a deer stalker Duncan Mackenzie has adopted a radical approach to management that keeps numbers down, has improved the quality of the herd and is helping regeneration in this iconic part of Scotland. He's also a committed local historian who has single-handedly rediscovered the lost village of Balblair, a once thriving community from where his ancestors were brutally evicted during the Highland Clearances.

videos.title: Colmcille: An Naomh Dána
videos.description: He was at the centre of a bloody battle and founded a monastery that became a beacon of civilisation in the Dark Ages. He's even said to have taken on the Loch Ness Monster. But who was Colmcille, the Irish abbot, known in Scotland as St. Columba? Born in AD 521, his exploits as poet, scribe, politician, warrior and holy man became notorious throughout Ireland and Scotland.

videos.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach
videos.description: Tha sinn a' sreap am broinn eigh-shruthan, a' tighinn faisg air ròin, mucan-mara dhronnach agus mathain bàna gus tuigse fhaighinn air mar a tha beatha agus nàdar ag atharrachadh. We see how science and nature can prepare us for the future.

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Oona and Baba have spotted a dung beetle, a special little creature on an important mission to roll his dung ball back to the nest! The beetle is highly skilled, but there are many obstacles in his way and he may need help from some friends.

videos.title: Creag nam Buthaidean
videos.description: Mama has hurt her wing and cannot join Papa on today's fishing trip. Oona is determined that she will help Papa instead but, between strong winds and menacing seagulls, Oona will need to show just how brave she can be!

videos.title: Boban is Fuigheag
videos.description: Feumar Fuigheag a shocrachadh an-diugh nuair a tha rud steigeach a' steigeadh ris. Fuigheag is not happy when a roll of sticky tape sticks to him. Boban must try to calm him down before things get worse and they end up stuck together.

videos.title: Losgannan
videos.description: Tha Sif, Pipp is Bran a' dèanamh geamannan à stràbhan is biadh sa ghàrradh.

videos.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach
videos.description: Owl wants to enter a drawing contest, but fearing his work is not good enough, he throws it away. Fox brings the discarded drawing to Hare and they decide to send it in secretly.

videos.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag
videos.description: During a stargazing night with his parents and Rita, Pompon is delighted to discover a constellation bearing his name. Unfortunately, Rita finds no such honour, which slightly spoils her evening.

videos.title: Stòiridh
videos.description: Eilidh Cormack reads 'Heidi am Falach' written and illustrated by Fiona Woodcock and translated into Gaelic by Jo Macdonald.

videos.description: Patrick meets an enthusiastic stranger at the bus terminal and leads him on a tour of his favourite places in Bikini Bottom.

videos.description: Foghlam Fiadhaich air a' bhlàr a-muigh aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche. Mr Mackle is under pressure, and he can't seem to get any respite. Meanwhile, Ms Dallas is delighted that Colonel Clisham is visiting the school to teach a camouflage class.

videos.title: Flix
videos.description: At school, some of the cats aren't all that impressed that Flix is a dog, so he embarks on a mission to find his true superpower by turning himself into Super Flix.

videos.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan
videos.description: Tink accidentally gets the twins tangle-spanged and tries to find grubs to cure them, unaware that Gubbo has invented a machine to round up all the grubs and starve the gumbles out of existence.

videos.title: Bogaisean is Gumbalan
videos.description: When the gumbles are attacked by one of Smiggles' dream creatures, Merri and Jolli wake Smiggles up and get captured in the process. Tink decides to impersonate a dream creature in order to save his friends.
